criteria.text: Trusted shell validates iframe messages before brokering.
Capabilities bind session, call, server, resource, mode, content hash, and expiry.
Replay, expiry, malformed payloads, and binding mismatch fail closed.
Transport supports responses, async events, timeouts, disconnect, and teardown.
No API token or raw MCP connection reaches iframe.
Live sandbox request reaches next gate and executes nothing.

not_tested: Live isolated sandbox cannot run in this worker because socket binding is prohibited; test is env-gated for the orchestrator.
